description: Ministry of Labour and Trade Union Relations - Industrial Disputes between Samastha Lanka Motor Sewaka Samithiya  and Sri Lanka Transport Board and two other notices
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the exercise of statutory powers under the Industrial Disputes Act to appoint arbitrators for industrial disputes. It contains legal orders made under specific legislative authority (Section 4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act), references to amended acts, and formal legal procedures for dispute resolution. While it mentions a Minister's name, this is in the context of executing legal powers rather than detailing portfolio responsibilities or making personnel appointments, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
